traditional: 一次 + 攞 A 嚟玩
jyutping: jat1 ci3 lo2 A lei4 waan2

english.note: Use this event construction for one particular act of making someone the object of teasing or amusement.

examples.english: That one tease really annoyed me all day.
examples.traditional: 嗰次佢一次攞我嚟玩，搞到我嬲咗成日。
examples.jyutping: go2 ci3 keoi5 jat1 ci3 lo2 ngo5 lai4 waan2 gaau2 dou3 ngo5 nau1 zo2 seng4 jat6
